about_the_game:
Idunn's grace has fallen upon the most unlikely of heroes: a small slime. In this retro-inspired puzzle-platformer adventure, you must master the power of the four elements to bring a dying forest back to life.

A Tale of Myth and Revenge

The giant Thjazi has stolen Idunn's golden apples, condemning the gods to old age and the forest to decay. In a final act of desperation, the goddess imbues a slime with her power, entrusting it with the mission to retrieve the apples and restore balance. Embark on a tale of hope and perseverance inspired by Norse mythology.

Master the Elemental Slime

Thanks to Idunn's blessing, our hero can switch between four elemental forms to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Each form offers unique abilities and its own handicaps, forcing you to think strategically in every level.
  • Water Form (Aegir): Revitalize plants to open new paths and carry small objects. But beware the cold, as it will freeze you solid!
  • Fire Form (Logi): Burn through wooden obstacles and survive the coldest climates. However, it cannot cross wooden structures.
  • Earth Form (Dvalin): Immune to hostile elements and capable of breaking weak structures. Its great weight prevents it from jumping at all.
  • Wind Form (Njord): Possesses a great jumping ability and can maneuver in the air. It is difficult to control in windy areas.

Key Features

  • A platforming game where changing elements is the key to progress.
  • Levels designed for the strategic use of the slime's different elemental forms.
  • Dynamic puzzles that will change their solution in each playthrough.
  • The difficulty of the levels will demand the best of you to overcome this adventure.
  • Pixel art graphics that will take you back to the era of 16-bit consoles.
  • Original soundtrack with influences from the great games of the 90s.
  • A story of hope and overcoming based on Norse mythology.

The fate of the forest is in your hands. Do you have the cunning and skill to guide our hero on their journey, outsmart Thjazi's ingenious puzzles, and return the apples to Idunn?
